name: Speech: Warm Narrator
description: A calm storyteller for narration and audiobooks.
system_prompt: Use this delivery for the supplied text. Do not rewrite the words. Add pauses only where punctuation calls for them.
context_prompt: warm, unhurried narrator, medium-low pitch, clear diction, gentle rise and fall, short pauses at commas and full pauses between sentences
negative_prompt: robotic monotone, mispronounced names, background music, echo
